entries.en: the sky clears; (of rain) to stop so that the weather clears up

entries.zh: 使人生疑、涉嫌；（教会语境）令人愤慨、立恶表
entries.en: to arouse suspicion; to give scandal, to shock or offend
entries.notes: 西语词头带缩写符"~"，M 栏存两读"siap gy / xe gy"，按"涉疑"义取。

entries.zh: 冲撞；强行冲出、破围而逃
entries.en: to break out by force, to force one's way out; to dash against

entries.zh: 杜猴（蝼蛄，穴居土中的虫）；西语栏以 escarabajo（甲虫）对译
entries.en: mole cricket (burrowing insect); glossed by the author as escarabajo (beetle)
entries.notes: 西语栏后半"comesca rabajos~"拼读残混，且官话栏"īn hên"与"杜猴"音不合，按汉/闽两栏"杜猴"义取。

entries.zh: 冻露（凝冻成冰的露水，即霜）
entries.notes: M 栏多出音节"pillo"未能定读，核心义"凍露"由汉/官两栏互证。

entries.en: to hoe up (the soil); to weed
entries.notes: H 栏末字耒/來存[疑]，按"耰起來"读，对译 escardar（锄、耘）。

entries.zh: 朱砂（红色矿物颜料）；猩红色、绯红色
entries.en: cinnabar (red mineral pigment); scarlet (color or cloth)
entries.notes: H 硃/砂、M se/sa、R ja/sha 三栏均存异读[疑]，按朱砂（红颜料）义取。
M/R 两栏空白，L 栏存[疑:fuerza/fuente]，H 栏混入拉丁缩写，仅可辨 escarmentar（受警戒而改过）一线索。

entries.en: to scorn, to hold in contempt; to mock

entries.notes: H 嘻/嗐、M hai/hi、R soy/hai 均存异读[疑]，按嗤笑义取。

entries.zh: 嘻笑哄弄；嘻嘻讥笑、作弄人
entries.en: to laugh at mockingly ('hi-hi'); to jeer and make fun of
entries.notes: H 第三字呍/哄存[疑]，M"chiô"与 R"sian"异读，按嘻笑作弄义取。

entries.zh: 取笑人、拿人作笑柄（譬相人）
entries.en: to mock people, to make fun of someone
entries.notes: M siô/fiô 与 R piâng/siâng 存[疑]，中间音节未定，按"譬相人"（以人取笑）义取。

entries.zh: 被人作弄、遭人嘲弄（乞人舞弄）
entries.en: mocked, scorned; made a plaything of by others (passive construction)
respected elder, superior; (Spanish column escarnecidor 'mocker' does not match — suspected column mispairing)
entries.notes: 西语词头 escarnecidor（嘲弄者）与汉/闽/官三栏"尊长 hun-tiang"语义相悖，疑栏位错配或词头残损，语义无法定夺，暂从三栏多数之"尊长"。
